name: Charlottetown — CMHC purpose-built apartment vacancy rate, October 2025
description: Share of privately initiated purpose-built rental apartment units in Charlottetown CA that were vacant and available for immediate rental in October 2025 (CMHC Rental Market Survey).

attributes.notes: Private apartment vacancy rate, all bedroom types: October 2024 0.7%, October 2025 1.6% (quality 'c'). Two-bedroom only: 0.7% → 1.9% (quality 'c'). year_over_year_change_pct left null because the change is in percentage points.

sources.title: Rental Market Survey Data Tables, Charlottetown CA, 2025 (Table 1.1.1)
sources.methodology: CMHC Rental Market Survey, October 2025: privately initiated purpose-built rental apartment structures of three or more units; survey of landlords/property managers; quality grades a–d, ** = suppressed.

verification.notes: Value read from the CMHC Excel data table downloaded on 2026-10-30.

limitations: Vacancy measures units vacant and ready to rent on the survey date; it excludes condominium rentals and secondary market units. A low rate signals a tight market but says nothing about asking rents.
